topic: Picking Up a Package after Missing the Carrier Notice

script.title: AT THE POST OFFICE
script.story_hook: One little notice card hides a very big box.
script.intro_zh: 一張小小的取件通知卡，藏著一個巨大的紙箱。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the post office counter today. Listen for handy pickup phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的郵局櫃台。留意實用的取件說法。
script.outro: And that's a package saved from going back. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一箱果醬就這樣留了下來。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a petite older woman in her sixties with short silver hair in soft waves, large round glasses, a plum purple rain jacket, a foldable shopping cart in hand, and a thin build
script.char_b_description: a tall lean man in his thirties with thinning brown hair, a thick mustache, a dark blue postal polo shirt, a scanner gun at his belt, and a tired but kind face

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, this little slip was on my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ðɪs ˈlɪɾəl slɪp wəz ɑn maɪ dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我家門口出現了一張這樣的小單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the carrier notice. Did it say why?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðə ˈkæɹiɚ ˈnoʊtɪs dɪd ɪt seɪ waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 啊，是快遞員留的取件通知。上面有寫原因嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says, arrived, no answer, signature needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz əˈɹaɪvd noʊ ˈænænsɚ ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ ˈnidɪd/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫：已送達、沒人應門、需要簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, so you were home and heard nothing?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm soʊ ju wɚ hoʊm ænd hɝd ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，所以你在家卻什麼都沒聽見？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, our doorbell has been dead since spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aʊɚ ˈdɔɹˌbɛl həz bɪn dɛd sɪns spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們家的門鈴從春天開始就壞掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains a lot on this route, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ə lɑt ɑn ðɪs ɹut ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這條線路上這種事常有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anyway, can I just collect the package now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌwɛ kænaɪ dʒʌst kəˈlɛkt ðə ˈpækɪdʒ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 總之，我可以現在直接領取包裹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's the notice number at the top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wɑts ðə ˈnoʊtɪs ˈnʌmbɚ æt ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 好，通知單最上面的號碼是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me see... zero four, dash, seven seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi si ˈzɪɹo fɔɹ dæʃ ˈsɛvən ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……零四、橫線、七七。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Last name and street, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt læst neɪm ænd stɹit pliz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。請給我您的姓和街道名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Maeve, on Orchard Lane, apartment nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts meɪv ɑn ˈɔɹtʃɚd leɪn əˈpɑɹtmənt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我姓 Maeve，住 Orchard Lane 九號公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mmm, the system wants your full first name.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɜm ðə ˈsɪstəm wɑnts jɔɹ fʊl fɝst neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，系統要的是完整姓名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maeve Halloran, with two R's in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪv həˈlɔɹən wɪθ tu ɑɹz ɪn ðə ˈmɪɾəl/
dialogue.zh: Maeve Halloran，中間有兩個 R。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found you, page two of my paper list.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ju peɪdʒ tu ʌv maɪ ˈpeɪpɚ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 找到你了，在我紙本清單第二頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, I felt invisible all morning long.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ fɛlt ɪnˈvɪzəbl̩ ɔl ˈmɔɹnɪŋ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 噢太好了，我一整個上午都覺得自己不存在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, nobody forgets a seven day hold here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊbɑdi fɚˈɡɛt ə ˈsɛvən deɪ hoʊld hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，在這裡七天的存放沒有人會忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So where is my box? I walked twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛɹ ɪz maɪ bɑks aɪ wɔkt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那我的箱子在哪？我走了二十分鐘過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big brown box, label on the side, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ braʊn bɑks ˈleɪbl̩ ɑn ðə saɪd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大大的棕色紙箱，側面有標籤，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! That's my sister's jam shipment for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts maɪ ˈsɪstɚz dʒæm ˈʃɪpmənt fɚ ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對！那肯定是我姐寄的果醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on shelf four, back room, right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ʃɛlf fɔɹ bæk ɹum ɹaɪt saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 在後面倉庫的第 4 層架，右側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's huge. Did they pack a car?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts hjuːdʒ dɪd ðeɪ pæk ə kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，超大。他們不會塞了輛車進去吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close. It's a rice cooker plus a towel set.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs ɪts ə ɹaɪs ˈkʊkɚ plʌs ə ˈtaʊəl sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了。是一台電鍋加一條毛巾組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister really ships half of her kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstɚ ˈɹɪli ʃɪps hæf ʌv hɚ ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我姐真的會把半個廚房寄過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Family boxes win the heavyweight prize, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli ˈbɑksɪz wɪn ðə ˈhɛviˌweɪt praɪz tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 相信我，家人寄的箱子永遠是重量冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I cannot carry that home alone, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ ˈkɑnɑt ˈkæɹi ðæt hoʊm əˈloʊn fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 可是我的朋友，我沒辦法獨自把它搬回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any neighbor nearby who could lend a hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈneɪbɚ ˈnɛɹbaɪ hu kʊd lɛnd ə hænd/
dialogue.zh: 附近有鄰居可以來幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, maybe Dara downstairs; she loves that jam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈmeɪbi ˈdæɹə ˌdaʊnˈstɛɹz ʃi lʌvz ðæt dʒæm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，樓下的 Dara 或許可以，她最愛那罐果醬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or, we can just redeliver it tomorrow, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɹ wi kən dʒʌst ˌɹi dɪˈlɪvɚ ɪt təˈmɑɹoʊ fri/
dialogue.zh: 或者我們可以直接明天免費重新派送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You would bring it back to my door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ju wʊd bɹɪŋ ɪt bæk tə maɪ dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你們會再把它送到我門口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. Just sign this small slip right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp dʒʌst saɪn ðɪs smɔl slɪp ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是的。就在這裡簽這張小單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Happy to. What time does the truck come?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə wət taɪm dʌz ðə tɹʌk kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。卡車會幾點到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Between ten and two, no promises tighter than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈwin tɛn ænd tu noʊ ˈpɹɑməsɪz ˈtaɪtɚ ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 十點到兩點之間，沒法給更準的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll water my plants right by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl ˈwɔɾɚ maɪ plænts ɹaɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就邊澆花邊守著窗戶等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan. One more thing, may I see ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ meɪ aɪ si ˌaɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 好。還有一件事，能看一下身分證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, here's my license and library card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs hɪɹz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ænd ˈlaɪbɹɛɹi kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是駕照和圖書館借書卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is this the address right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪz ðɪs ði əˈdɹɛs ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這是現在住的地址嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, though I moved there only this past March.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðoʊ aɪ muvd ðɛɹ ˈoʊnli ðɪs pæst mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，不過我今年三月才剛搬過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New folks share wrong mail for a year, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu foks ʃɛɹ ɹɔŋ meɪl fɚ ə jɪɹ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 新搬來的總有收到錯信的時候，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking of mail, how many days do you hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspikɪŋ ʌv meɪl haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz du ju hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 說到信，你們可以代收幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven days, then it rides back to sender.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən deɪz ðɛn ɪt ɹaɪdz bæk tə ˈsɛndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 七天，之後就退回給寄件人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, close call, this notice is six days old.
dialogue.phonetic: /u kloʊs kɔl ðɪs ˈnoʊtɪs ɪz sɪks deɪz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 噢好險，這張通知單已經六天了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So tomorrow is your last comfortable day, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ təˈmɑɹoʊ ɪz jɔɹ læst ˈkʌmftɚbl̩ deɪ tɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 所以明天真的是你最後從容的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, I keep missing this poor cardboard box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ aɪ kip ˈmɪsɪŋ ðɪs pʊɹ ˈkɑɹdbɔɹd bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 唉，怎麼每次都錯過這個紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, the box missed you too.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɝi ðə bɑks mɪst ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，箱子也很想你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That's the kindest thing a clerk said.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ðə ˈkaɪndəst θɪŋ ə klɝk sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這是櫃員說過最暖心的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I aim for kind and quick both, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈeɪm fɔɹ kaɪnd ænd kwɪk boʊθ ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我一向要求自己又暖心又迅速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign right now or at delivery?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ saɪn ɹaɪt naʊ ɔɹ æt dɪˈlɪvɚi/
dialogue.zh: 我現在簽，還是送到的時候簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, please. Initial the little box beside it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ pliz ɪˈnɪʃəl ðə ˈlɪɾəl bɑks bɪˈsaɪd ɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 現在簽。旁邊的小格也要簽名字縮寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There. Is there a number I can text?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ɪz ðɛɹ ə ˈnʌmbɚ aɪ kən tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 好了。有可以傳簡訊的號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No texting, but call and ask for Rina.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtɛksɪŋ bət kɔl ænd ˈæsk fɚ ˈɹinə/
dialogue.zh: 我們不傳簡訊，但可以打電話找我 Rina。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rina with the friendly scanner, noted forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹinə wɪð ðə ˈfɹɛndli ˈskænɚ ˈnoʊtɪd fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 帶著親切掃描機的 Rina，我記一輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, bring your cart, maybe everything fits inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bɹɪŋ jɔɹ kɑɹt ˈmeɪbi ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ fɪts ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，帶你的推車來，說不定全都裝得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes walking, honestly it's good exercise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈɑnəstli ɪts ɡʊd ˈɛksɚsaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 走二十分鐘，老實說正好當運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've made my slow afternoon, that's for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz meɪd maɪ sloʊ ˈæftɚˌnun ðæts fɚ ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 可以這麼說，你讓我的下午亮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too. Oh, will they knock loudly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu oʊ wɪl ðeɪ nɑk ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 你也是。噢，他們會用力敲門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They pound hard when doorbells stop working.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ paʊnd hɑɹd wɛn ˈdɔɹˌbɛlz stɑp ˈwɝkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 門鈴壞掉時，他們就會猛敲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great plan. All in all, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt plæn ɔl ɪn ɔl θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。總而言之，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Shelf four is now your friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ʃɛlf fɔɹ ɪz naʊ jɔɹ fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。第四層架現在是你的朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you tomorrow, Rina. Bye, jam box.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈɹinə baɪ dʒæm bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 明天見，Rina。再見了，果醬箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take care, and mind that heavy bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ˈkɛɹ ænd maɪnd ðæt ˈhɛvi ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 慢走，小心箱子底部很重。

script.youtube_title: 【錯過取件單📦】「箱子也很想你」😆｜60句郵局聽力教你請重新派送🚚🎧｜聽完就能自己去取件｜Post Office Package Pickup
script.youtube_title_en: "The Box Missed You Too" — Picking Up a Held Package at the Post Office
script.youtube_description:
「箱子也很想你」——快遞員在門上留下取件通知，你卻完全沒聽見門鈴？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在郵局櫃台前。

你會聽到：拿著通知單補領包裹的開場說法；報單號、姓名、地址與證件的完整核對；箱子太重搬不動時，怎麼請行員隔天重新派送；還有門鈴從春天就壞掉、地址剛搬新的那些真實小狀況。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人每天用的自然語感：um、well、so、oh、honestly。聽完你就會用：Can I collect...、we can redeliver it、ask for...、how many days do you hold 這類實戰句。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The box missed you too" — the carrier left a notice on your door and you never heard the doorbell. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the post office counter.

You will hear: opening lines for picking up a missed package, giving the notice number, full name, address and ID; asking for a free redelivery when the box is far too heavy; plus real small mishaps like a doorbell dead since spring and a brand-new address.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the natural rhythm Americans use every day: um, well, so, oh, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like Can I collect..., we can redeliver it tomorrow, and ask for Rina.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
門口多了一張取件通知，家裡的門鈴卻從春天就壞了，這種事你是不是也遇過？箱子重到搬不動，該請郵局幫忙明天再送一次嗎？

這一集帶大家走進郵局櫃台，從出示通知單、核對姓名地址與身分證，到簽單預約免費重新派送，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📦 補領開場：Anyway, can I just collect the package now?
🪪 核對身分：Good plan. One more thing, may I see ID?
🚚 請行員隔天再送：Or, we can just redeliver it tomorrow, free.
🖊️ 簽名句：Should I sign right now or at delivery?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、oh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這趟郵局之行走一趟，下次收到通知單，話就自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你明天就在自家門口，收到那箱想念你很久的包裹。
